high_level_description: This image is a digital illustration featuring a stylized figure of a person with a unique and surreal design. The figure is depicted from the back, wearing a black dress that extends to just above the knees. The most striking feature of the figure is the large, detailed dragonfly wings that span across the back, creating an illusion as if the person is wearing or emerging from the wings. The background of the illustration is a circular frame filled with a starry night sky, giving the impression that the figure is floating or emerging from the cosmos.
